title: This lint requires Future implementations returned from functions and methods to implement the Send marker trait, ignoring type parameters.
summary: A Future implementation captures some state that it needs to eventually produce its final value. When targeting a multithreaded executor (which is the norm on non-embedded devices) this means that this state may need to be transported to other threads, in other words the whole Future needs to implement the Send marker trait. If it does not, then the resulting Future cannot be submitted to a thread pool in the end user’s code. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.
